method: revenue rank x criticality (judgement) x competition (graded from disk)

basis.revenue: pricing_aim_source_lines.parquet, priced_both == True, billed euro summed by PN
basis.competition: 2 = alternative visible with its price (KS or Eucon); 1 = alternative visible by PN (Autodoc names) ; 0 = nothing on disk

caveats: Criticality is a judgement, not a measurement. It is a mapping from the catalogue family to the cost of the vehicle being off the road. Edit and re-run.
Competition grade 1 rests on the Autodoc file's part-number and brand columns only. Its price column is unusable (277 of 298 rows carry the identical 2.34).
Grade 0 means nothing on disk, NOT that no competitor exists. It is a statement about our evidence, not about the market.
Margins are the class-implied margins. The cost behind them is FOB euro implied by the class, not a purchase cost.
